tests.reason: The per-step owner and the Commerce MCP status shape are pure and proven by Jest over mocked Supabase; the read-only staging suite has no signed-in gateway probe (staging shares the production database). These suites pin the stepOwner table per step key and verification code, the stale-row case (R1-F1), the website code (R1-F2), that buildChecklist adds only owner, that shapeStatus carries owner on steps and next_action while done_on_vitanaland/link/tool/supplier_action stay byte for byte, the typeless/complete/empty next_action.owner cases, and that the derived ON_SCREEN_STEPS equals exactly the five supplier-action keys (R2-F1).
